_comment: Use Case 2 (BIFM Ops: Withdrawal & Contribution Audit Document Automation). Document types + audit-pack composition, cross-checked against BIFM's own real sample documents (Ops Samples.zip, 2026-07-22) and the KGISL/BIFM requirements-clarification call transcript on top of the original proposal. 'required: false' = the proposal's 'where applicable' items: their absence is noted on the pack manifest but does not mark the pack incomplete. Two client types matter here and change which documents genuinely exist for a given transaction: POOLED (BIFM executes an actual trade in a shared fund - a Trade Order/Trading-tool document exists) vs SEGREGATED (money moves straight to/from the client's own account - no fund trade, so no Trade Order/Template; confirmed by real WITHDR-SEGREGATED and CONTRI-SEGREGATED samples containing no trade-order-style document at all).

document_types.name: Client Withdrawal Instruction
classification_hints: we hereby request that a cheque be drawn
portfolio name / portfolio code / amount table

document_types.name: Investment Team Approval / Instruction Email
classification_hints: kindly receive the attached and advise

document_types.name: Trade Order Document (Trading Tool)
classification_hints: schedule of investments listing many individual securities/holdings with a market value per instrument, for ONE fund (e.g. a '[PF:XHLD8A]' schedule) - not a table of portfolio-level cash movements, that is CASH_FLOW_STATEMENT instead

document_types.name: Cash Flow Statement
classification_hints: a table with one row per PORTFOLIO (not per security), columns like Cash Trade Id / Portfolio Code / Date / Transaction Type / Amount, transaction type values like Withdrawal or Deposit

document_types.name: Proof of Payment
classification_hints: debtor account is BIFM, beneficiary is a client/third-party bank account (money moving OUT to the client)

document_types.name: Client Contribution / Additional Investment Instruction
classification_hints: source of funds for this investment

document_types.name: Deposit Confirmation Letter
classification_hints: client confirms they have sent money to BIFM

document_types.name: Proof of Transfer (BIFM to investment inflow account)
classification_hints: beneficiary is a BIFM-owned inflow account (e.g. name/nickname containing BIFM), money moving IN to BIFM

document_types.name: Cash Template
classification_hints: same shared daily cash report used for withdrawals - see CASH_FLOW_STATEMENT hints

document_types.name: Trade Template
classification_hints: same trading-tool output used for withdrawals - see TRADE_ORDER hints
only present for pooled clients - a segregated client's contribution has no trade template

Withdrawal.note: Trade Order Document (Trading Tool) - only exists for pooled clients, where BIFM executes an actual fund trade; a segregated client's withdrawal pays out directly with no trade to record (confirmed: real WITHDR-SEGREGATED sample has no trade-order document)
Bank Statement / Proof of Payment - where applicable (BIFM only generates this for pooled-client payouts it makes itself, or on ad hoc auditor request)

Contribution.note: Client's own contribution / additional investment instruction, where the client submits one (e.g. BIFM UT's Additional Investment Form) - institutional contributions confirmed in BIFM's real samples were captured straight into the cash/trade templates below with no separate instruction letter on file, so this isn't required, only filed as evidence when present
Client Proof of Payment / Deposit Confirmation Letter
Proof of Transfer from the BIFM account to the investment inflow account

Cash Template - captured the same day for every contribution (unlike the withdrawal cash record, which is captured the next day); same shared daily cash file as CASH_FLOW_STATEMENT, so either code satisfies this
Trade Template - only exists for pooled clients (an actual fund purchase happens); a segregated client's contribution is captured under the cash template only, with no trade
